messages:
Priya N: Heads-up: embeddings returning intermittent 503s in eu-west1. We built hotfix image `registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-6421`. Need expedited window and quick signoff to push. Plan: canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%.
DeployBot: preflight OK, but canary in eu-west1 failed: InsufficientReservedGPU.
Marco V: Suggest diverting canary to eu-south1 dedicated pool (has spare GPUs) rather than shared pool. Anyone object?
OpsOnCall: I approve diversion to eu-south1 with strict rollback: rollback if 5xx > 1% for 3m or P95 latency +250ms. Keep initial canary at 5% and enable auto-rollback.
Priya N: Thanks. I'll pin and start canary once Marco confirms. Smoke checklist: /health, dims, no OOM, eviction metric down.
Marco V: Pinned and kicking canary: `releasetool pin --svc embeddings --img registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-6421 --region eu-south1 --canary 5% --auto-rollback true`. Canary id cb-6421204321.
DeployBot: canary cb-6421204321 started. Metrics @5%: 5xx=0.08%, P95 +40ms.
Priya N: Infra smoke green. Model smoke running (quick eval 20 prompts).
DeployBot: eval 20 -> 19/20 pass (1 formatting edge case). No rollback triggers. Moving to 50% after 3m watch.
OpsOnCall: Monitoring. Proceed when both smokes ack.
Marco V: 50% steady, proceeding to full ramp.
DeployBot: rollout complete, pinned registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-6421. Closing canary cb-6421204321.
Priya N: Filing postmortem and follow-up to add earlier reserved-pool autoscale and cross-region spill policy. :white_check_mark:
